findings.evidence: plan A1 injects a Tauri-native Documents resolver into the spawned Python backend but defines no executable host-to-backend transport or lifecycle
findings.root_cause: native Documents authority has no specified production communication edge to SessionCreationService

findings.evidence: plan B1 requires a validated owner key stable across profile generations and OS-user isolated but names no existing identity source or completed spike
findings.root_cause: user-global ownership root is an unresolved prerequisite

findings.evidence: plan exposes project_committed and session_committed states while also saying Project Session binding and receipt commit in one DB transaction
findings.root_cause: state machine intermediate states contradict the proposed database transaction boundary

findings.evidence: multiple Projects may have different succeeded versions for one capability but B1 defines no deterministic collapse into one user binding
findings.root_cause: many Project authorities collapse into one user authority without conflict policy

findings.evidence: three slices mutate coupled persistent authorities without one schema dependency graph backup boundary restore procedure or partial-slice rollback test
findings.root_cause: forward migration and downgrade rejection are specified without recoverable rollback unit

findings.evidence: plan names broad suites but no exact fixture Skill commands UI action oracle cold-restart or evidence-to-scenario mapping
findings.root_cause: verification goals are not reproducible decisive procedures
